analyst.summary: Aarti Drugs is a bulk-drug/API manufacturer coming off a multi-year industry pricing correction. FY26 revenue was Rs.2,565 Cr with a 12% operating margin, and the most recent quarter (Jun-2026) showed the best margin in over a year (14%), suggesting the cyclical downturn in API pricing is bottoming out. The balance sheet is sound (moderate debt, ~9x interest cover) and the stock trades at a fair, not expensive, ~19-20x earnings. We see this as a stable holding rather than a name to exit or add aggressively.
